+def test_zero_size_input():
+    """
+    Test that empty arrays are handled correctly in WCS transformations.
+    Issue: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/...
+    """
+    w = wcs.WCS(naxis=2)
+    w.wcs.crval = [1, 1]
+    w.wcs.cdelt = [0.1, 0.1]
+    w.wcs.crpix = [1, 1]
+    
+    # Test with empty lists
+    result = w.wcs_pix2world([], [], 0)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert len(result[0]) == 0
+    assert len(result[1]) == 0
+    
+    # Test with empty array (Nx2 format)
+    result = w.wcs_pix2world(np.array([]).reshape(0, 2), 0)
+    assert result.shape == (0, 2)
+    
+    # Test wcs_world2pix with empty arrays
+    result = w.wcs_world2pix([], [], 0)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert len(result[0]) == 0
+    assert len(result[1]) == 0
+    
+    # Test wcs_world2pix with empty array (Nx2 format)
+    result = w.wcs_world2pix(np.array([]).reshape(0, 2), 0)
+    assert result.shape == (0, 2)
